rows.corpus_definition: Recorded on a digital disc or video format.
rows.example_en: I have the movie on DVD.

rows.corpus_definition: Doing something because you wanted to, not by mistake.
rows.example_en: He did not break the vase on purpose.

rows.corpus_definition: Happening exactly at the planned or expected time.
rows.example_en: The train arrived exactly on schedule today.

rows.corpus_definition: The raised floor where people perform in a theater.
rows.example_en: The singer looked great on stage.

rows.corpus_definition: The person you are playing or fighting against in a contest.
rows.example_en: My opponent played a very good game.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who competes against you in a game or argument
rows.example_en: His opponent scored two goals in the final match.

rows.corpus_definition: A choice that you can make.
rows.example_en: We have another option if this plan fails.

rows.corpus_definition: Not special, different, or strange; quite normal.
rows.example_en: It was just an ordinary day at work.

rows.corpus_definition: When a machine is broken and not working.
rows.example_en: The elevator is out of order.

rows.corpus_definition: during or for the whole night; happening very quickly or suddenly
rows.example_en: The town became famous almost overnight after the news.

rows.corpus_definition: To have an obligation to give money back to someone.
rows.example_en: I owe my friend ten dollars.
